scope: Yardman vehicle and reusable asset production
authorization_basis: owner-provided project source material and owner-provided procedural sources
allowed_from_project_sources: glass lamps trim and underbody components
textures materials UV evidence and shaders
vehicle rigs animations and attachment points
engine exhaust intake transmission turbo tire road wind impact and mechanical audio
vehicle VFX and reusable technical vehicle components
garage and vehicle-presentation components when they do not import a source-game world/map
owner-provided procedural generation scripts and geometry scaffolds
excluded_from_ingestion: source-game road networks as replacement geography
outside_asset_rule: Do not introduce third-party assets from outside the owner-provided Yardman source pool unless the owner explicitly approves that source.

brand_policy.porsche: active when present in owner-authorized project sources
brand_policy.tesla: active when present in owner-authorized project sources

quality_policy.optimization: use LOD, streaming, residency, pooling and AI eligibility controls rather than degrading player-facing hero assets
quality_policy.motorsport_variants: may ship as exact player-selectable vehicles; keep out of ambient/AI traffic when marked player-only

provenance: Every promoted asset must retain exact source/procedural provenance and must pass the normal identity, generation/trim, visual, physics, audio and Android gates.
